items.exampleZh: 她的微笑傳達了她的喜悅。

items.exampleEn: An electrical problem stopped the train.
items.exampleZh: 一個電力故障讓火車停了下來。

items.exampleEn: It is hard for me to understand his accent.
I didn't know the caller, so I didn't answer.
items.exampleZh: 我不認識那位來電者，所以沒接。

items.exampleEn: Turn the modem off and on again.
items.exampleZh: 把數據機關掉再重新開啟。

items.exampleEn: This keyboard is too small for my hands.
items.exampleZh: 這個鍵盤對我的手來說太小了。

items.exampleEn: Please fax the form to our office.
items.exampleZh: 請把表格傳真到我們辦公室。

items.exampleEn: Copyright laws protect writers and artists.
items.exampleZh: 版權法保護作家和藝術家。

items.exampleEn: He dialed the wrong number and talked to a stranger.
items.exampleZh: 他撥錯號碼，跟一個陌生人講了話。

items.sentenceEn: Can you send it to me by fax?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以用傳真寄給我嗎？

items.audioEn: If the caller can't hear you, hang up and dial the number again in five minutes.
items.audioZh: 如果對方聽不到你的聲音，請結束通話，五分鐘後再撥一次。
items.questionZh: 對方聽不到時該怎麼做？
options: Write the number down on a piece of paper.
Send a message to the office manager.
End the call and try again later.
Speak more loudly for five minutes.

items.sentenceEn: The electrical shop closes at nine.
Every photo in this book is protected by copyright.
items.sentenceZh: 這本書裡的每張照片都受版權保護。

items.stemEn: Please type your password using the ____.
items.stemZh: 請用鍵盤輸入你的密碼。

items.stemEn: It's hard to ____ your feelings in a short text message.
items.stemZh: 用簡短的簡訊很難傳達你的感受。

items.passageEn: On my first day at the new office, nothing worked. The modem was broken, so there was no internet. The keyboard on my computer was missing two keys, and an old fax machine in the corner made strange noises. An electrical worker came to check all the office equipment. Then my phone rang. The caller had a strong accent, so I asked him to speak more slowly. He wanted to send us a song for our company video, but my boss said we must check the copyright first. In the end, I tried to convey all of this to my boss in one short email.
items.passageZh: 我在新辦公室上班的第一天，什麼都不順。數據機壞了，所以沒有網路。我電腦的鍵盤少了兩個鍵，角落的舊傳真機還發出奇怪的聲音。一位電工來檢查辦公室所有的設備。接著我的電話響了。打電話來的人口音很重，所以我請他說慢一點。他想寄一首歌給我們拍公司影片用，但老闆說我們得先確認版權。最後，我試著用一封簡短的電子郵件把這一切傳達給老闆。

questions.questionZh: 老闆說用那首歌之前要先做什麼？
options: 先付錢給打電話來的人
先問過所有同事的意見

items.promptZh: 那位來電者想找我爸爸。
referenceEn: The caller wanted to talk to my father.
The caller asked for my dad.
rubricZh: caller 表示「來電者、打電話的人」，例如 the caller 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 她說英文帶一點法國口音。
referenceEn: She speaks English with a slight French accent.
She has a slight French accent when she speaks English.
rubricZh: 用 accent 表示「口音」（例如 with a French accent）
「一點」可寫，例如 a slight、a little 等
